content.value_statement: Volcengine VoiceChat integrations involve changing APIs, models, audio settings, and runtime stages. This skill provides safe configuration guidance, official documentation routing, and evidence-based troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Explain Volcengine AI audio and video capabilities and their configuration boundaries.
Generate, modify, and validate VoiceChat and Aibot configuration structures.
Route documentation questions through read-only search and fetch workflows.
Diagnose web integration failures by authentication, media, agent, ASR, LLM, and TTS stages.
Map runtime symptoms to the strongest available evidence and a next verification step.
Explain RTC and VoiceChat error codes through the vertc CLI when available.
limitations: It does not replace current official documentation for changing APIs, models, limits, or pricing.
It cannot prove a product limitation from missing local documentation or an incomplete demo.
CLI execution requires vertc, suitable project access, and user authorization.
It does not expose, store, or recover AppKey, Signin credentials, or other secrets.

use_cases.title: Plan a VoiceChat demo
use_cases.description: Choose a web integration path, map required stages, and identify the configuration evidence needed before implementation.

use_cases.title: Build an agent configuration
use_cases.description: Translate natural language goals into VoiceChat or Aibot settings for ASR, LLM, TTS, prompts, and playback.

use_cases.title: Find the first integration failure
use_cases.description: Use logs, callbacks, and runtime events to locate the earliest missing or failed stage in a voice conversation.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how a Volcengine VoiceChat web demo moves from user speech to agent audio. List the main stages and one success signal for each.

prompt_templates.title: Create a configuration plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal VoiceChat configuration plan for a web assistant with Chinese speech recognition, a conversational LLM, and spoken replies. Mark values that need current documentation verification.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a configuration change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed VoiceChat configuration change. Identify structural issues, dynamic fields that need official verification, and the smallest safe correction. Do not invent unsupported values.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a missing reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this VoiceChat incident from the supplied events. Return the symptom, domain, last confirmed success, first failure or missing evidence, action, and one verification step. Preserve uncertainty.

output_examples.input: The user joins successfully, but the agent never replies.
output: Next evidence: check whether the user audio was published and whether an ASR result arrived.
Do not classify the LLM or TTS stage as failed without later evidence.

output_examples.input: The agent text arrives, but no audio reaches the browser.
output: Last confirmed success: agent text delivered.
First unresolved stage: TTS, agent audio publication, or downstream audio delivery.
Collect the next audio event before blaming browser playback.

output_examples.input: A configuration uses an unfamiliar model and voice resource.
output_examples.output: The structure can be checked locally. Model, provider, resource, and voice compatibility require current official documentation or a service response.

best_practices: Separate confirmed product capability, configuration limits, demo coverage, and unverified claims.
Use the earliest failed or missing stage instead of listing every possible cause.
Keep credentials out of prompts, logs, configuration files, and diagnostic output.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a search snippet, stale reference, or missing demo feature as proof of product support.
Do not request or repeat AppKey, Signin credentials, authorization codes, or environment file contents.
Do not infer TTS, LLM, or playback failure before collecting the relevant runtime evidence.

faq.question: Can this skill create VoiceChat configurations?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps natural language requirements to core configuration structures and identifies values that need current verification.

faq.question: Can it update an existing Aibot?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan an Aibot update, but it needs the current baseline before producing a safe merge patch.

faq.question: Does it use current documentation?
faq.answer: It routes changing API and product questions to official documentation lookup. It marks facts as unverified when lookup is unavailable.

faq.question: Can it run the vertc CLI?
faq.answer: It can guide or run CLI workflows when vertc is available and the user authorizes actions that change the environment.

faq.question: How does it diagnose no response?
faq.answer: It follows the conversation stages and stops at the first failed or missing evidence instead of guessing the cause.

faq.question: How are credentials handled?
faq.answer: The skill must not request, repeat, store, or log AppKey, Signin credentials, authorization codes, or environment file contents.
